label: materialEntityCategory controlled concept scheme
definition: A SKOS Concept Scheme to be used as a controlled vocabulary for the Darwin Core terms dwc:materialEntityCategory and dwciri:materialEntityCategory

label: mineral
definition: A naturally occurring element or chemical compound of homogeneous composition, normally with a crystalline structure, and resulting from some geological process on Earth or in extraterrestrial bodies.

label: rock
definition: Consolidated aggregate of one or more Earth materials, or a body of undifferentiated mineral matter, or of solid organic material. Includes mineral aggregates such as granite, shale, marble; glassy matter such as obsidian; and organic material such a coal. Excludes unconsolidated materials.

label: fossil
definition: Any remains, trace, or imprint of a plant or animal preserved in the Earth's crust since some past geologic or prehistoric time; loosely, any evidence of past life.
